lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in three distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, forming a staggered grid-like spatial configuration on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a rectilinear pattern of nodes across the visible lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent longitudinal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient transitioning from a highlighted upper edge to a shadowed lower margin.

other_distinctive_markers: A large remora (Echeneidae) is attached to the lateral flank above the pectoral fin, and several smaller remoras are visible trailing from the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
